name: SectionHeading
description: Section heading block: eyebrow, title (level 2-4), description and actions, with left/center alignment and three sizes.
designIntent: Marketing and content pages repeat the same eyebrow/title/description/actions cluster for every section. SectionHeading standardizes it without claiming the page h1 (that is PageHeader's job).

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level rendered for the title.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the title element for host display typography.

props.name: descriptionClassName
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the description paragraph.

props.name: eyebrowClassName
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the eyebrow/kicker.

examples.title: Marketing section
examples.code:
<SectionHeading
  eyebrow="Components"
  title="Built for agents"
  description="Every component ships a spec."
  actions={<Link href="/docs">All docs</Link>}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for the page title
antiPatterns.explanation: PageHeader owns the single h1; SectionHeading defaults to h2.

accessibility.implementation: Renders h2/h3/h4 via the level prop
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the hierarchy sequential under the page h1

compositionRules.relationship: PageHeader for the h1; SectionHeading for h2+ sections
